articles.title: I’m a journalist. Israel detained me for documenting the olive harvest in the West Bank.
articles.author: Ricardo Esteves Ribeiro
articles.content_excerpt: Israel is detaining international observers for one simple reason: to prevent us from reporting on its ethnic cleansing project in Palestine.

articles.title: One barricade after another: How protesters marched on the garrisoned heart of India’s capital
articles.author: Pavan Kulkarni
articles.content_excerpt: 60,000 security personnel were deployed across India’s national capital on October 10.​ This included the police of Delhi and neighboring states, as well as paramilitary forces pulled from regions of India affected by armed insurgencies. articles.title: South Africa anti-immigrant protests turns violent
articles.author: Nicholas Mwangi
articles.content_excerpt: Last week, anti-immigrant protests in South Africa turned violent, with looting, destruction of property, and reports of 24 vehicles being burnt as tensions escalated in Johannesburg and Durban. The unrest followed growing anger over a government directive on asylum applications, which the Department of Home Affairs has since withdrawn. The directive, issued on September 28, instructed Refugee Reception Offices (RROs) to process all asylum applications immediately. Massive queues of foreign nationals subsequently formed at immigration offices, which were met with demonstrations and violence from anti-immigrant groups.
